description: This file defines the StorageComparer class in Drupal, responsible for comparing and synchronizing configuration storage data, managing changelists, and handling cache wrapping for configuration storages.

classes.name: StorageComparer
classes.description: Defines a class for comparing and managing configuration storage differences in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StorageComparer with source and target storage objects, setting up cache storages and collection handling.

methods.name: getSourceStorage
methods.description: Returns the source storage for a given collection, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getTargetStorage
methods.description: Returns the target storage for a given collection, wrapping in cache if not in write mode.

methods.name: writeMode
methods.description: Enables write mode, disabling static cache wrapping for the target storage.

methods.name: getEmptyChangelist
methods.description: Returns an empty changelist structure with create, update, delete, and rename arrays.

methods.name: getChangelist
methods.description: Retrieves the changelist for a specific operation and collection.

methods.name: addChangeList
methods.description: Adds changes to the changelist, optionally sorting them.

methods.name: createChangelist
methods.description: Generates the full changelist for all collections, including create, update, delete, and rename operations.

methods.name: addChangelistDelete
methods.description: Creates delete operations sorted to respect dependencies.

methods.name: addChangelistCreate
methods.description: Creates create operations sorted to respect dependencies.

methods.name: addChangelistUpdate
methods.description: Creates update operations, handling recreates and dependencies.

methods.name: addChangelistRename
methods.description: Creates rename operations based on UUID matching.

methods.name: removeFromChangelist
methods.description: Removes a specific item from a changelist operation.

methods.name: moveRenameToUpdate
methods.description: Converts a rename operation into an update.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the changelist and cache states, then regenerates the changelist.

methods.name: hasChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are any pending changes in the changelist.

methods.name: validateSiteUuid
methods.description: Validates that the site UUIDs in source and target storage match.

methods.name: getAndSortConfigData
methods.description: Loads and sorts configuration data from source and target storages.

methods.name: createRenameName
methods.description: Creates a combined name for renaming based on old and new names.

methods.name: extractRenameNames
methods.description: Extracts old and new names from a rename string.

methods.name: getAllCollectionNames
methods.description: Returns all collection names from source and target storages.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares object for serialization, excluding target storages.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Restores object state after unserialization, resetting caches.
